subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): surface accountId on agent hook context

question: Should `ctx.accountId` be accepted as the canonical public plugin hook-context field, and should the exported helper reject the internal `agentAccountId` alias before merge?
rationale: The PR changes a public plugin SDK contract; automation can remove the alias, but only maintainers can approve the canonical public field name and whether any secondary helper input is supported.

options.title: Approve accountId, remove alias
options.body: Accept `ctx.accountId` as the public SDK field and require internal callers to map `agentAccountId` to `accountId` before using the exported helper.

options.title: Document both names
options.body: Accept the alias as public API too, with documented precedence and a deprecation or support plan.

options.title: Pause for naming
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose a different account identity field name or broader SDK shape.

recommendation.title: Approve accountId, remove alias
recommendation.body: Accept `ctx.accountId` as the public SDK field and require internal callers to map `agentAccountId` to `accountId` before using the exported helper.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the hook contract type split and are the strongest history signal for `PluginHookAgentContext` API direction.
